lastTask: Implement Byte L4c-2 evolution sparkline visualization

projectState.summary: Byte L4c-2 is implemented on codex/byte-l4c2-evolution-sparkline and ready for Claude review. The melody editor now has a collapsed-by-default read-only Evolution panel using the existing editor-<songId> candidate catalog read. It summarizes unfiltered phrase candidates into best/mean fitness per generation plus elite/alive/reserved/purged tally, renders a compact SVG sparkline, and exposes window.phraseEditor.getEvolution() for deterministic inspection. The visible catalog remains non-purged-only and sorted by fitness. No evolution algorithm, persistence endpoint/schema, scorer, renderer, transport, scheduler, or candidate-store logic changed. Validation: build green, six unit suites green, db:smoke green, targeted evolution smoke green, full smoke 78/78, failed-slice targeted rerun 4/4 after one transient unrelated full-smoke failure, confirmation full smoke 78/78, diff-check green; npm audit still reports known Vite/esbuild advisories.
